ctb.duplicateMotion: Add a Motion again from the Motion tool
ctb.lockHint: Lock: the canvas no longer selects or moves this layer (the panels still edit it)
ctb.lockedHint: Locked: select it on the timeline; unlock it to move it on the canvas
ctb.replaceImageHint: Replace this image: pick another image in Media
ctb.replaceVideoHint: Replace this video: pick another video in Media (at least as long as this clip)
ctb.replacing: Pick an image or a video in Media to replace the selected one

fit.label: Fit to the frame
fit.coverHint: Fill the whole frame (what falls outside the frame is not shown)
fit.containHint: Show the whole picture inside the frame

notYet.reason: Not available yet: the video cannot keep or draw it

aspect.undoHint: Everything changes in one step; one Undo puts it all back.
aspect.failed: The format could not be changed. It may not be enabled yet, or the project changed meanwhile.

impact.recovered: {count, plural, one {# picture that fills the frame fills} other {# pictures that fill the frame fill}} the new frame too
impact.refitted: {count, plural, one {# fitted picture is} other {# fitted pictures are}} fitted to the new frame
impact.moved: {count, plural, one {# layer keeps its place} other {# layers keep their place}} in the frame and {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} moved into the safe area
impact.review: {count, plural, one {# picture} other {# pictures}} could not be measured: check {count, plural, one {its} other {their}} place after the change
impact.motion: {count, plural, one {# Motion layer was} other {# Motion layers were}} made for another format and will not be shown until replaced

notices.copied: Copied. Press Ctrl+V to paste it.
notices.copyUnsupported: This layer cannot be copied. Add a Motion again from the Motion tool.
notices.pasteDoesNotFit: The copied video is longer than this scene.
notices.pasteUnsupported: This layer cannot be pasted here.
notices.pasteMissingSource: The copied media is no longer in this project.
notices.replaceKind: Pick the same kind: an image for an image, a video for a video.
notices.replaceTooShort: That video is shorter than the clip it would replace.
notices.replaceFailed: The media could not be replaced.
notices.redoSoon: Redo is not available yet. Undo is Ctrl+Z.
